title: Weinstein tells Jim Simons about Chern-Simons and Einstein-Hilbert; Stony Brook invitation
place_text: meeting with Jim Simons; Simons Center, Stony Brook

tellings.quote: So, look, I I more or less accused Jim Simons of this shortly before he died.

plain: Shortly before the billionaire mathematician Jim Simons died, the researcher Eric Weinstein says he more or less accused Simons of something tied to Chern-Simons theory, a piece of mathematics that bears Simons's name, and the Einstein-Hilbert equations behind Einstein's gravity. Weinstein tells this as his own meeting, which he links to an invitation to the Simons Center at Stony Brook in New York. In his words: "I more or less accused Jim Simons of this shortly before he died."
